cases.title: Full refund of a captured payment restores the pre-capture balance
cases.expected: The gateway records one full refund and the customer balance equals the pre-capture balance

cases.title: Partial refund leaves the remainder captured
cases.expected: Captured balance equals the original capture minus the refunded sum

cases.title: Confirmation shows Refunded only after the gateway accepts
cases.expected: The confirmation status is Refunded when the gateway result is accepted, and unchanged while the result is pending

cases.title: Retry after an accepted refund times out does not submit a second refund
cases.expected: The gateway receives one refund call and the caller observes REFUNDED

diff_only.note: The diff tests a non-positive amount branch. No AC, journey step, or failure mode states that case.
